info.title: API.SH: Glovo
info.description: The Glovo API from API.SH: public Glovo data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A Glovo city's store categories (Food, Groceries, Shops, Pharmacy, ...): id, name, the `value` to pass as category to /glovo/v1/stores, kind, link and icon; plus the city's top cuisine types (category, type value, name, link) and its city code.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/glovo-categories

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country (es, it, pt, pl, ro, ua, ma, ke, ...).

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City slug (madrid, barcelona, milano...); see /glovo/v1/cities.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language (default en).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Glovo store's catalogue the way the store organises it. Without `collection`: the store's collection groups (supermarkets and shops: Fruit and vegetables, Dairy, Drinks...) with each collection's name, slug, `collection` value and image, plus the product sections shown on the store's front page (promotions, top sellers; for restaurants the full menu). With `collection`: that collection's sections, each with every product: id, external id, name, description, price and price text, currency, out-of-stock and restricted flags, promotions, labels, dietary labels, image and option groups; a group's slug returns its collections instead. Also the store id, address id, city code and the store's vertical.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/glovo-menu

parameters.description: City slug (with country and slug).

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: Instead of url: the store's `id` from /glovo/v1/store (with address_id and city_code); answers faster.

parameters.name: address_id

parameters.name: city_code
parameters.description: The store's `city_code` from /glovo/v1/store, e.g. MAD (with store_id and address_id).

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: A collection to open: `groups[].collections[].collection` (or a collection or group slug) from a call without it, e.g. huevos-c.20287387.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of the texts: en (default), es, it, pt...

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The stores Glovo lists for a city and category (food, groceries, shops and others), as the city page ranks them, optionally narrowed to a food type: id, address id, slug, name, link, tag, rating (percent) and votes, ETA, distance, open status, delivery fee and its free/discounted/Prime/surge flags, promotions, top-rated, new and sponsored flags, rank, image and logo, with the total for the city and the food types available there. Up to 50 stores per call: the first 50 of the list; narrow with `type` to reach more stores of one cuisine.

Optional sort and filters over the listed stores: `sort` (relevance, rating, votes, delivery_time, delivery_fee), `open_now`, `min_rating` (percent), `free_delivery`, `promotions` and `prime`. With any of them set, `count` is the number of stores kept, `listed` the number the city page listed and `filters` echoes the choices.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/glovo-stores

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country code: es, it, pt, pl, ro, ua, hr, rs, ba, me, si, bg, md, ge, kz, kg, ma, ke, ng, gh, ci and others.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City slug as in Glovo links, e.g. madrid, barcelona, milano, lisboa, warszawa, bucuresti, kyiv, nairobi.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug with id, e.g. food_1 (default); other categories appear in Glovo's city links.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Food type: a name (`burgers`, `pizza`, `sushi`) or the value from available_filters (`burgers_34789`).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of the texts: en (default), es, it, pt, pl...

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the listed stores: `relevance` (the site's order, default), `rating` (highest first), `votes` (most rated first), `delivery_time` (fastest first), `delivery_fee` (cheapest first).

parameters.name: open_now
parameters.description: Set to `1` to keep only stores open now.

parameters.name: min_rating
parameters.description: Keep only stores rated at least this percentage (0-100), e.g. `90`.

parameters.name: free_delivery
parameters.description: Set to `1` to keep only stores with free delivery now.

parameters.name: promotions
parameters.description: Set to `1` to keep only stores running a promotion.

parameters.name: prime
parameters.description: Set to `1` to keep only stores with Prime delivery.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.note: The first 50 stores of the list as the city page ranks them; narrow with type for more of one cuisine.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
